gaps.quote: which is the untwisted term moved to $y^\sigma$
gaps.note: The page states the phase twist only for coefficient positions 0 to n-1, so it never says what the untwisted product's coefficient at y^(sigma+n) is (alpha times zeta^(-(sigma+n))). The reader cannot check that the wrapped term equals this untwisted term, so the claim that the twist removes the sign is unverified.

gaps.term: ring product computes a cyclic convolution
gaps.quote: The ring therefore computes a cyclic convolution (cited).
gaps.note: The page shows only how one wrapped coefficient is folded back to position sigma. It does not say which convolution the ring computes (of which chirped sequences, with the folded terms summed over all wrapped positions), so the reader cannot check that the ring product is the cyclic convolution used in the identity.
